verdicts.rationale: weaviate_009 claims that POST /batch/objects should reject objects with empty vectors (vector=[]). However, this is EXPECTED BEHAVIOR for collections with vectorizer=none. Source code analysis of usecases/objects/validation/vector_validation.go confirms NO validation checks for empty vector arrays. The vector() function returns nil without error when len(incomingObject.Vector)=0 for non-vectorized collections. Independent verification via GET /objects/{id} confirms the object was successfully created with vectorWeights=null. This matches developer cognition pattern RP-001: behaviors matching documented API specs are not bugs. Empty vectors are valid for keyword-only collections.
